Method of Attack: Improper intent handling allowing malicious applications to abuse the flaw to download and potentially install malware on devices
Malicious third-party mobile applications can transmit data resulting in malicious files being downloaded
Using the app's web browser functionality, malicious sites can be accessed and malicious files downloaded and executed
Impacted Systems: KYOCERA Mobile Print v3.2.0.230119 and earlier
UTAX/TA Mobile Print v3.2.0.230119 and earlier
Olivetti Mobile Print v3.2.0.230119 and earlier
Attack Vector: Abuse of vulnerable printing apps by installing a second malicious application on the device that triggers payload download
